title: Films that Receive a Popularity Boost in the Streaming Age

commenti.body:
>I'm curious if anyone else has any other noteworthy examples? Even just anecdotally, where you keep coming across people who've seen a movie that you didn't realize was particularly popular or gaining popularity. It's always interesting to see what gets revived by the cultural zeitgeist, especially in an age where we seemingly have infinite choices for art to consume.

One film that comes to mind immediately is *Come and See* \-- a Russian film from 1985 that seems to have really gained a following among 21st century Anglophone cinephiles. I don't remember anyone talking about it on IMDB circa 2009-2010 or so. But now in 2023, it's achieved basically meme levels of popularity in this little subculture.

A filmmaker who's really undergone a critical revival/rise in popularity over the past few decades is Jean-Pierre Melville. This was of course catalyzed by the 2006 rerelease of *Army of Shadows* (I think this was the film's first theatrical release in the United States).
